job.title: Civil Construction Supervisor – Power Generation
job.description:
Civil Construction Supervisor – Power Generation (Owner's Representative)

Location: Cedar Creek, Texas (Bastrop County)
Employment Type: Long-Term W2 Contract
Contract Duration: Initial 2-year commitment, with potential extension through 2029
Pay Rate: $90–$100 per hour
Per Diem: $181 per day, subject to eligibility
Work Arrangement: On-site

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Civil Construction Supervisor / Owner's Representative to support the construction of a major 1,100 MW natural gas-fired power generation facility in Cedar Creek, Texas.

This large-scale, multi-unit, modular simple-cycle power generation project will provide critical electricity infrastructure supporting high-demand data center operations.

Working directly on behalf of the project owner, you will provide independent field oversight of all civil and structural construction activities undertaken by the Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) contractor and its subcontractors.

You will play a key role in ensuring that earthworks, foundations, concrete structures, underground utilities and associated civil infrastructure are constructed safely, efficiently and in accordance with approved engineering designs, contractual requirements and applicable industry standards.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced civil construction professional seeking a long-term assignment on a major power generation project.

Key Responsibilities

Civil Construction Oversight

  • Act as the owner's on-site representative for civil and structural construction activities.

  • Monitor EPC contractor and subcontractor performance across site preparation, grading, excavation, earthworks and foundations.

  • Oversee piling, concrete placement, underground utilities, drainage systems, access roads and associated site infrastructure.

  • Verify that civil construction activities comply with Issued for Construction (IFC) drawings, engineering specifications and contractual requirements.

  • Review construction readiness, sequencing and constructability to identify potential issues before they affect project execution.

  • Monitor civil construction progress, identify schedule risks and escalate issues to project leadership.

  • Coordinate interfaces between civil, structural, mechanical and electrical construction teams.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Review contractor construction plans, method statements, inspection and test plans (ITPs), and technical submittals.

  • Verify earthwork compaction, geotechnical requirements, foundation installation and concrete quality.

  • Conduct independent field inspections and monitor contractor QA/QC activities.

  • Identify and formally document construction defects, deviations and non-conformances.

  • Issue and track owner Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) independently of the contractor's quality management process.

  • Verify corrective actions and ensure outstanding quality issues are resolved to the owner's satisfaction.

  • Maintain accurate inspection records, construction reports and supporting documentation.

Health, Safety & Environmental Oversight

  • Monitor EPC contractor compliance with project safety requirements, OSHA regulations and applicable environmental standards.

  • Conduct site safety inspections, field walks and behavioral safety observations.

  • Identify unsafe working conditions and escalate unresolved issues to project leadership.

  • Exercise the owner's stop-work authority where imminent safety hazards are identified.

  • Ensure civil activities are appropriately coordinated with work in or around energized or potentially energized electrical environments.

Project Coordination & Reporting

  • Participate in daily Plan of Day (POD), End of Day (EOD) and construction coordination meetings.

  • Collaborate with project management, engineering, EPC contractors and other site representatives.

  • Review construction documentation, field reports and contractor deliverables.

  • Support resolution of technical queries, construction conflicts and field engineering issues.

  • Maintain clear records using project construction management software.

  • Provide regular updates on construction progress, quality performance, safety concerns and outstanding actions.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of civil construction experience, including at least 3 years supporting large industrial, energy or power generation projects.

  • Previous experience in an Owner's Representative, Owner's Engineer, EPC Construction Supervisor or similar field-based construction oversight role.

  • Strong knowledge of civil construction activities including earthworks, grading, piling, concrete foundations, drainage, underground utilities and site infrastructure.

  • Experience working on power plants, natural gas generation facilities, major industrial facilities or comparable heavy construction projects.

  • Ability to interpret IFC drawings, civil and structural specifications, geotechnical reports, construction calculations and survey information.

  • Experience reviewing contractor method statements, inspection and test plans, and quality documentation.

  • Strong understanding of civil construction QA/QC, field inspections, non-conformance reporting and corrective action management.

  • Familiarity with applicable ACI, ASTM, AASHTO, OSHA and environmental requirements.

  • Strong communication, contractor coordination and technical reporting skills.

  • Ability to work independently and represent the owner's interests in a fast-paced construction environment.

  • Willingness to work on-site in Cedar Creek, Texas, including extended hours or rotational schedules as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience overseeing civil works on gas-fired power generation or other large-scale energy infrastructure projects.

  • Experience working directly for project owners or independent owner's engineering teams.

  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification.

  • Familiarity with construction management platforms and digital field reporting systems.

  • Experience coordinating civil construction interfaces with major mechanical equipment, electrical infrastructure and power plant systems.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $90–$100 per hour (W2)

  • $181 daily per diem, subject to eligibility

  • Two weeks of paid time off

  • $1,000 mobilization/demobilization allowance

  • $500 monthly home travel allowance

  • Initial two-year contract commitment

  • Potential long-term assignment through the end of 2029

  • Opportunity to contribute to a major 1,100 MW power generation development

Site vehicles will be available for project-related activities; however, candidates must have their own transportation to and from the project site.

Apply Today

If you are an experienced Civil Construction Supervisor, Civil Superintendent or Owner's Representative with a background in power generation or major industrial construction, we would welcome your application.

Join a major infrastructure project where your expertise in civil construction oversight, contractor management, quality assurance and field execution will directly contribute to successful project delivery.

job.title: Project Scheduler / Planner
job.description:
Project Scheduler / Planner

Location: Dallas, TX or Austin, TX




Our client is a global energy infrastructure business delivering large-scale power generation projects, supporting the growing demand for reliable energy infrastructure.



Reporting directly to the Director of Project Controls, the Project Scheduler / Planner will play an important role in developing and managing project schedules across a portfolio of large-scale power generation projects.

This is a hands-on opportunity within a growing team, with approximately 60% of the role focused on project planning and 40% on scheduling.




You will be responsible for developing and maintaining project schedules, establishing scheduling governance, and coordinating project activities across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and turnover.

The successful candidates will be comfortable taking ownership, working independently, and collaborating with multiple project stakeholders to ensure delivery against key milestones.



Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and update integrated project schedules using Primavera P6.
  • Establish and maintain scheduling governance, processes, and reporting standards.
  • Support project planning across pre-construction, engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning.
  • Manage project milestones, dependencies, critical paths, and schedule baselines.
  • Monitor project progress against established schedules and identify potential delays or risks.
  • Coordinate with project managers, engineering teams, EPC contractors, and external stakeholders.
  • Identify scheduling conflicts and develop mitigation and recovery plans.
  • Provide regular progress updates and scheduling reports to project leadership.
  • Support construction sequencing and Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) activities.
  • Ensure schedules remain accurate, aligned, and reflective of project delivery requirements.



Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant project planning and scheduling experience, ideally 6–8+ years.
  • Strong, hands-on experience with Primavera P6.
  • Experience independently developing, maintaining, and managing complex project schedules.
  • Background in power generation, particularly gas-fired generation or utility-scale renewable energy projects.
  • Understanding of scheduling governance, critical path management, dependencies, and project milestones.
  • Experience working with cross-functional project teams and external contractors.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership within a growing project controls team.




Preferred Experience

  • Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) experience.
  • Experience with EPC, EPCM, IPP, energy developers, or power generation businesses.
  • Direct data center power infrastructure experience.
  • Experience across the full project lifecycle, including commissioning and turnover.
  • Knowledge of schedule risk analysis, resource loading, and earned value management.
  • Relevant project controls or scheduling certifications.



Location & Travel

The positions will be based in either Dallas or Austin, Texas.

The working arrangement will depend on location:

  • Austin-based: Three days per week onsite at the project site, with regular travel to Dallas for team meetings.
  • Dallas-based: Three days per week onsite in the office, with weekly travel to the Austin project site.

Approximately 30–40% travel is expected, so candidates must be comfortable travelling regularly between locations.

job.title: Senior Piping Designer – Oil & Gas Facilities
job.description:
Senior Piping Designer – Oil & Gas Facilities

Location: Houston, TX (100% Onsite)
Pay Rate: $72.70 per hour
Contract Duration: 12 months
Schedule: Full-time, standard business hours

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Senior Piping Designer to join an established engineering team supporting oil & gas facilities, pipeline infrastructure and plant construction projects in Houston, Texas.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a variety of engineering and construction initiatives, developing detailed piping designs, technical drawings and project documentation to support safe, efficient and cost-effective project execution.

The successful candidate will have a strong background in piping design, Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), equipment layouts and engineering documentation, with the ability to coordinate effectively across engineering, project management, procurement and construction teams.

Key Responsibilities

Piping Design & Engineering Documentation

  • Develop and maintain piping designs, general equipment layouts, facility plot plans and technical drawings for oil & gas facilities, pipelines and related infrastructure.

  • Prepare and update Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), equipment layouts and associated engineering documentation.

  • Assign piping line numbers, equipment tags, instrument tags and valve identification numbers in accordance with project requirements.

  • Review, revise and maintain engineering drawings, including record drawings and as-built documentation.

  • Resolve drawing development issues and ensure technical documentation accurately reflects engineering requirements.

  • Support the development and maintenance of company engineering standards, drawings and drafting procedures.

Project Engineering & Coordination

  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Engineers and Construction Contractors to ensure piping designs align with project scope, technical requirements and construction schedules.

  • Assist in developing project scopes, engineering and design scopes, and construction scopes of work.

  • Participate in project meetings to clarify design requirements, address technical challenges and recommend practical engineering solutions.

  • Coordinate the preparation, review and distribution of engineering design packages to relevant stakeholders.

  • Support preliminary engineering and conceptual design activities for proposed projects.

  • Assist with design activities on time-sensitive and budget-critical projects.

Materials, Procurement & Technical Support

  • Prepare material take-offs (MTOs), equipment lists, instrument lists and piping material documentation.

  • Develop material data sheets, parts lists and material requisitions for project approval.

  • Coordinate with vendors and suppliers to obtain material quotations, confirm availability and clarify technical specifications.

  • Work alongside procurement personnel, inspectors and contractors to resolve material and construction-related design issues.

  • Support engineering documentation associated with in-service welding activities, including Pre-Assessment Letters (PALs), where required.

Quality, Documentation & Team Support

  • Maintain accurate records of technical design decisions, engineering correspondence and project documentation.

  • Review design schedules and estimated engineering hours to support efficient project delivery.

  • Coordinate with CADD Operators and other drafting personnel to maintain drawing accuracy and consistency.

  • Provide technical guidance to other designers and drafting personnel.

  • Contribute to improvements in engineering workflows, drafting standards and document management procedures.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Significant professional experience in piping design and drafting within oil & gas, midstream, pipeline, petrochemical or industrial processing facilities.

  • Strong experience preparing and modifying P&IDs, PFDs, equipment layouts, facility plot plans and piping-related engineering drawings.

  • Experience developing piping line lists, equipment and instrument lists, material take-offs and material requisitions.

  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications and construction documentation.

  • Understanding of piping systems, valves, instrumentation, equipment arrangements and industrial facility design.

  • Experience coordinating design activities with engineering, construction, procurement and project management stakeholders.

  • Proficiency with computer-aided design and drafting (CADD) tools.

  • Strong attention to detail, technical problem-solving abilities and organizational skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple design deliverables while meeting project deadlines.

Desirable Experience

  • Previous experience supporting midstream oil & gas infrastructure, pipeline facilities, terminals or processing plants.

  • Familiarity with AutoCAD, AutoCAD Plant 3D or other industry-standard piping design platforms.

  • Experience supporting brownfield modifications, facility upgrades or operational plant engineering projects.

  • Knowledge of piping design standards and industry codes, including applicable ASME and API requirements.

  • Experience coordinating vendor drawings, material specifications and construction design packages.

Contract Details

  • Hourly Rate: $72.70

  • Duration: 12-month contract

  • Location: Downtown Houston, Texas

  • Work Arrangement: Fully onsite

  • Schedule: Standard full-time working hours

Why Apply?

This opportunity offers an experienced Senior Piping Designer the chance to work on technically varied oil & gas infrastructure projects while collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering and construction teams.

You will play an important role in delivering piping designs and technical documentation that directly support project execution, construction activities and operational facility improvements.

Apply today to learn more about this Senior Piping Designer opportunity in Houston, TX.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer to support enterprise networking infrastructure for an innovative organization operating within the automotive and technology sector.

Based in Palo Alto, California, this position will focus primarily on the design, configuration, maintenance and troubleshooting of on-premises enterprise networks, including Cisco Nexus switching, Fortinet firewalls, wireless networking and secure site-to-site connectivity.

The successful candidate will act as a senior technical escalation point, taking ownership of complex network issues, supporting business-critical infrastructure and collaborating with internal IT teams and external vendors.

In addition to core network engineering responsibilities, the role will provide exposure to AWS hybrid cloud networking, including Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, VPC endpoints and Route 53.

This is a hands-on engineering position suited to someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges and proactively improving network reliability, security and performance.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Network Infrastructure

  • Design, install, configure, maintain and optimize enterprise LAN/WAN network infrastructure.

  • Manage Cisco Nexus 9000 series switches, routers, wireless access points and associated network hardware.

  • Support the configuration and administration of Fortinet FortiGate firewalls.

  • Troubleshoot complex routing, switching, connectivity and network performance issues.

  • Maintain secure, reliable network connectivity across corporate offices, operational facilities and external sites.

  • Identify opportunities to improve network resilience, performance and operational efficiency.

Network Security, Wireless & VPN Connectivity

  • Configure, troubleshoot and maintain enterprise firewall policies, VPN connections and network security infrastructure.

  • Work directly with external vendors to establish, validate and maintain secure site-to-site VPN tunnels.

  • Support Cisco enterprise wireless infrastructure, including Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco DNA Center.

  • Diagnose wireless connectivity, authentication and network access issues.

  • Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to resolve network security and connectivity challenges.

  • Support secure connectivity between vendor environments and company facilities.

Advanced Troubleshooting & IT Support

  • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex network incidents and infrastructure-related support requests.

  • Investigate hardware, software, routing, firewall and connectivity issues to identify root causes.

  • Prioritize incoming support tickets based on business impact, operational urgency and service requirements.

  • Coordinate with remote IT teams and internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues efficiently.

  • Maintain clear technical documentation relating to network configurations, incidents and troubleshooting activities.

  • Proactively identify and implement network improvements during periods of lower support demand.

AWS Hybrid Cloud Networking

  • Support connectivity between on-premises enterprise networks and AWS cloud environments.

  • Assist with hybrid network routing using AWS Transit Gateway.

  • Support deployment and maintenance of AWS PrivateLink and private VPC endpoints.

  • Assist with hybrid DNS resolution using Amazon Route 53, including hosted zones and resolvers.

  • Utilize AWS networking monitoring tools, including VPC Flow Logs, CloudWatch Metrics and Transit Gateway Network Manager.

  • Investigate connectivity issues, latency and routing problems between physical facilities and AWS environments.

  • Collaborate with cloud and infrastructure engineering teams to maintain secure hybrid connectivity.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience in enterprise network engineering, administration and infrastructure support.

  • Demonstrated expertise configuring, managing and troubleshooting Cisco Nexus 9000 series switches.

  • Strong working knowledge of Cisco routing, switching and LAN/WAN networking technologies.

  • Practical experience configuring and supporting Fortinet FortiGate firewalls.

  • Experience establishing, configuring and troubleshooting site-to-site VPN tunnels.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise networking protocols, IP addressing, routing, DNS and network security.

  • Experience supporting Cisco wireless networking environments.

  • Familiarity with Cisco ISE and Cisco DNA Center administration or troubleshooting.

  • Proven ability to investigate and resolve complex network infrastructure incidents.

  • Experience working with vendors, internal IT teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Ability to independently prioritize technical issues and manage competing operational demands.

  • Strong communication, documentation and problem-solving skills.

  • Willingness to work in a hybrid arrangement in Palo Alto and travel up to 30% as required.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Experience supporting hybrid networking environments connecting on-premises infrastructure with AWS.

  • Knowledge of AWS Transit Gateway, AWS PrivateLink and VPC endpoints.

  • Familiarity with Amazon Route 53, including DNS resolvers and hosted zones.

  • Experience using AWS CloudWatch, VPC Flow Logs or other cloud network monitoring tools.

  • Relevant networking certifications, such as Cisco CCNP, CCNA or Fortinet certifications.

  • Previous experience supporting enterprise networks across multiple locations or operational facilities.

  • Experience working within automotive, manufacturing, technology or other complex enterprise environments.

Contract Details

  • Pay Rate: $86.66 per hour

  • Contract: Initial 6-month assignment

  • Location: Palo Alto, California

  • Work Arrangement: Hybrid

  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM

  • Travel: Up to 30%

Why Apply?

This opportunity offers an experienced Senior Network Engineer the chance to support a sophisticated enterprise network environment, working with Cisco, Fortinet and AWS networking technologies.

You will take ownership of challenging infrastructure issues, collaborate with technical teams and vendors, and contribute directly to the security, reliability and performance of business-critical network systems.

The position combines hands-on network engineering, technical troubleshooting and opportunities to develop further experience in hybrid cloud connectivity.

Apply today to learn more about this Senior Network Engineer contract opportunity in Palo Alto, CA.

job.title: Senior LNG Project Engineer – Cryogenic Systems
job.description:
Senior LNG Project Engineer – Cryogenic Systems

Location: Remote – United States
Contract Duration: 12 Months
Pay Rate: $52.96 per hour
Schedule: Standard Business Hours

About the Role

We are recruiting for an experienced Senior LNG Project Engineer to join a leading energy organisation, supporting the development and engineering design of critical LNG and natural gas infrastructure projects across the United States.

This fully remote position will focus on LNG facility design, cryogenic systems, natural gas transmission infrastructure, and front-end engineering development.

Acting as the Owner's Technical Design Authority, you will oversee engineering contractors, review complex technical deliverables, and ensure LNG and cryogenic infrastructure designs meet rigorous engineering, safety, and regulatory standards.

The position is focused on technical engineering and design oversight rather than day-to-day construction management.

Key Responsibilities

LNG & Cryogenic Engineering Design

  • Lead technical design oversight for LNG liquefaction, cryogenic storage, boil-off gas (BOG) handling, vaporisation systems, and natural gas pipeline interconnections.

  • Develop and review engineering Basis of Design (BOD), technical specifications, design criteria, and equipment requirements.

  • Evaluate cryogenic equipment specifications, including LNG storage tanks, cold-box heat exchangers, cryogenic pumps, compressors, vaporisers, and vacuum-jacketed piping.

  • Ensure engineering designs comply with applicable ASME, API, NFPA, and federal regulatory requirements.

FEED & EPC Contractor Management

  • Provide technical direction to engineering consultants and EPC contractors throughout Pre-FEED, FEED, and detailed engineering phases.

  • Review and approve multidisciplinary engineering deliverables, including Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), heat and material balances, piping isometrics, and equipment datasheets.

  • Lead engineering design reviews and ensure technical quality, design optimisation, and compliance with project requirements.

  • Review contractor RFIs, technical deviations, design change notices, and proposed change orders.

Natural Gas Transmission & Pipeline Infrastructure

  • Support engineering design of high-pressure natural gas pipeline interconnects and associated facilities.

  • Review metering and regulation (M&R) station designs, custody-transfer metering systems, pressure regulation equipment, and gas chromatographs.

  • Coordinate technical reviews involving pipeline hydraulics, flow assurance, and pressure control systems.

Process Safety & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with 49 CFR Parts 192 and 193, NFPA 59A, ASME B31.3/B31.8, and applicable API standards.

  • Coordinate and participate in HAZID, HAZOP, LOPA, constructability reviews, and multidisciplinary design assessments.

  • Support regulatory compliance activities involving PHMSA, FERC, and relevant state utility authorities.

  • Provide engineering input into management of change (MOC) processes, operating procedures, and emergency response documentation.

  • Participate in vendor technical reviews and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) activities.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline from an ABET-accredited programme.

  • Minimum 5 years of direct engineering design experience in LNG facilities, including liquefaction, cryogenic storage, peak-shaving, backup fuel systems, or LNG sendout facilities.

OR

  • Minimum 10 years of comprehensive engineering design experience in industrial cryogenic systems, including air separation, cryogenic hydrocarbons, liquid hydrogen, or liquid nitrogen.

Additional Requirements

  • Strong understanding of high-pressure natural gas transmission systems, pipeline interconnections, hydraulic flow assurance, or metering and regulation station design.

  • Proven experience reviewing and approving engineering contractor deliverables, including P&IDs, engineering calculations, and equipment specifications.

  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams and external EPC contractors.

  • Knowledge of LNG facility design standards, cryogenic equipment requirements, and process safety principles.

  • Valid driver's license.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer (PE) licence.

  • Master's degree in Mechanical, Chemical, or Cryogenic Engineering.

  • Experience with Aspen HYSYS, UniSim, Synergi Gas, SPS, or similar engineering simulation tools.

  • Familiarity with CAESAR II, AutoPIPE, or other pipe stress analysis software.

  • Understanding of cryogenic metallurgy, brittle fracture prevention, and low-temperature material selection.

  • Experience supporting FERC or state utility commission technical filings.

  • Previous experience serving as an Owner's Engineer or Technical Design Authority for LNG or natural gas infrastructure projects.

Why Apply?

  • Fully Remote: Work remotely within the United States.

  • Major Energy Infrastructure: Support complex LNG, cryogenic, and natural gas transmission projects.

  • Technical Leadership: Take ownership of engineering design reviews, technical assurance, and contractor oversight.

  • 12-Month Contract: Contribute to critical infrastructure development within an established energy organisation.

Apply Today

If you have a strong background in LNG facility engineering, industrial cryogenic systems, or natural gas infrastructure design, we encourage you to apply.

This opportunity is particularly well suited to experienced LNG Project Engineers, Process Engineers, Cryogenic Engineers, and Facilities Engineers looking to contribute to technically challenging energy projects.

With a diverse workforce, the business is continuing to evolve its operating model, with a growing focus on sales effectiveness, customer experience and operational excellence.



Working closely with senior leadership, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering the people strategy, developing talent and capability, and fostering a high-performance culture across the organisation.



This is an opportunity for an HR leader who enjoys operating strategically while remaining hands-on, using commercial insight, people initiatives and data to drive business performance and support long-term growth.

As the business continues to evolve, there is an opportunity to further develop the HR function and ensure its people strategy is aligned with the organisation's commercial objectives.



The role will have a particular focus on supporting the retail sales and customer-facing teams, strengthening talent and capability, and driving employee engagement and retention.

About You



You are an experienced HR leader who understands the relationship between people, culture and commercial performance. You are comfortable operating in a fast-paced, sales-focused environment and have the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and drive meaningful change.

job.title: Prevailing Wage and Compliance Audit Specialist
job.description:
Prevailing Wage & Apprenticeship Compliance Specialist (PWACS)

Location: Juno Beach, FL

Position Overview

The Prevailing Wage & Apprenticeship Compliance Specialist (PWACS) is responsible for supporting and overseeing prevailing wage and apprenticeship compliance across renewable energy projects subject to federal, state, and contractual labor requirements.

This role serves as a key liaison between project teams, contractors, subcontractors, and third-party compliance consultants to ensure all compliance obligations are understood, monitored, and fulfilled in a timely manner.

The PWACS will coordinate compliance activities, review and validate consultant deliverables and contractor submissions, monitor project compliance status, identify and escalate potential risks, and support the timely completion of project deliverables.

Key responsibilities include reviewing certified payroll and labor compliance documentation, tracking corrective actions, evaluating project-specific requirements, facilitating stakeholder meetings, and providing management with clear updates on compliance status, outstanding issues, and upcoming deadlines.

The ideal candidate will have strong attention to detail, excellent project coordination skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while proactively addressing compliance issues that could impact project schedules or tax credit eligibility.

Key Responsibilities

Compliance Oversight & Coordination

  • Oversee prevailing wage and apprenticeship compliance activities for assigned renewable energy projects.
  • Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, and third-party compliance consultants to ensure all compliance requirements are understood and fulfilled.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for prevailing wage and apprenticeship compliance matters throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Evaluate compliance with applicable federal, state, project-specific, and contractual requirements.

Documentation Review & Validation

  • Review consultant deliverables, compliance reports, and project documentation for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and adherence to project requirements.
  • Review certified payroll records, apprenticeship documentation, and supporting materials to verify compliance.
  • Validate wage classifications, fringe benefit contributions, apprenticeship utilization, and other applicable labor compliance requirements.
  • Compare contractor and consultant submissions against project tax, finance, legal, and contractual requirements.
  • Support audits, compliance reviews, and project closeout activities by ensuring required documentation is complete, accurate, and readily accessible.

Project Tracking & Risk Management

  • Monitor project compliance status, milestones, and reporting deadlines, escalating risks and delays as appropriate.
  • Track outstanding compliance issues, corrective actions, and documentation requests through resolution.
  • Identify potential compliance risks and support the development and implementation of corrective action plans.
  • Maintain and update compliance dashboards and tracking tools to support project reporting and decision-making.
  • Ensure compliance deliverables are completed accurately and within established deadlines.

Reporting & Stakeholder Management

  • Prepare compliance status reports, executive summaries, and risk assessments for project management and leadership teams.
  • Facilitate recurring compliance meetings with contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Communicate project status, deficiencies, corrective actions, and upcoming deliverables.
  • Collaborate with engineering, construction, tax, legal, and finance teams to support project compliance objectives.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and assist in developing compliance procedures, guidance, and best practices.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher.
  • Strong project coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with consultants, contractors, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience identifying compliance risks and implementing corrective action plans.
  • Ability to interpret complex requirements and communicate compliance expectations clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in compliance tracking tools, dashboards, and reporting systems.
  • Strong attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability for delivering accurate work products on time.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience managing third-party compliance consultants, auditors, or professional service providers.
  • Experience tracking project deliverables and driving issue resolution in deadline-driven environments.
  • Experience supporting Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) Prevailing Wage and Apprenticeship compliance programs.
  • Experience working with engineering, construction, tax, legal, and finance stakeholders on utility-scale renewable energy projects.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Change Management Specialist to provide hands-on organizational change management support for strategic business and technology initiatives.

The successful candidate will translate change strategies into effective execution across stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, communications, organizational readiness, learning and enablement, adoption measurement, and sustainment.

This is an execution-focused role requiring an individual who can work independently, quickly understand complex initiatives, develop high-quality change management deliverables, facilitate stakeholder engagement, and manage multiple priorities in an iterative delivery environment.

The specialist may support multiple initiatives or projects based on business priorities and organizational demand.



Key Responsibilities

1. Change Planning & Execution

  • Translate change strategies into detailed implementation and execution plans.
  • Develop and maintain change activity plans, deliverable schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, and action items.
  • Coordinate change activities across business, project, product, technology, communications, and training workstreams.
  • Support readiness and adoption activities throughout the initiative lifecycle.
  • Identify and escalate adoption risks, stakeholder concerns, execution gaps, and dependencies.

2. Stakeholder Engagement & Change Impact

  • Conduct and maintain stakeholder assessments and segmentation.
  • Support stakeholder interviews, workshops, working sessions, demonstrations, and feedback sessions.
  • Conduct and maintain change impact assessments across roles, processes, systems, workflows, behaviors, and ways of working.
  • Translate identified impacts into communications, learning, engagement, readiness, and reinforcement activities.
  • Track stakeholder feedback, concerns, resistance themes, and follow-up actions.
  • Support change champion, advocate, and superuser networks as appropriate.

3. Communications

  • Develop audience-specific communications, leadership messages, presentations, FAQs, talking points, release communications, and change materials.
  • Maintain integrated communication and engagement calendars.
  • Coordinate content reviews, approvals, timing, and distribution.
  • Create leader and manager toolkits to support consistent communication.
  • Translate complex project and technical information into clear, concise, audience-appropriate messages.

4. Learning, Enablement & Readiness

  • Assess learning and enablement needs based on stakeholder and change impacts.
  • Develop or coordinate role-based training materials, job aids, quick-reference guides, demonstrations, and support resources.
  • Coordinate training sessions, demonstrations, office hours, and other enablement activities.
  • Support readiness assessments and document risks, gaps, and mitigation actions.
  • Support post-launch reinforcement and learning activities.

5. Adoption, Feedback & Measurement

  • Establish and maintain mechanisms for collecting stakeholder and end-user feedback.
  • Analyze and synthesize feedback into actionable themes.
  • Support the development and tracking of readiness, adoption, engagement, and change-effectiveness measures.
  • Develop concise change-readiness and adoption reports for project and change leadership.
  • Monitor post-implementation adoption and identify additional intervention or reinforcement needs.

  • Adjust change deliverables as product functionality, business processes, implementation plans, and stakeholder impacts evolve.
  • Support pilot and user-feedback cycles and translate findings into subsequent change activities.
  • Work effectively in environments where scope, timelines, and stakeholder requirements may evolve.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience developing and executing stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, communications, readiness, learning and enablement, adoption, and reinforcement activities.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting multiple workstreams, releases, or concurrent initiatives while managing change deliverables against project milestones.
  • Strong business writing skills, including executive-ready presentations, leadership communications, employee communications, FAQs, talking points, and change materials.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation, and workshop skills, including experience working directly with business leaders, subject matter experts, project teams, and end users.
  • Ability to translate complex business, process, and technical information into clear, audience-appropriate communications and enablement materials.
  • Experience conducting stakeholder assessments and change impact assessments and translating findings into actionable change activities.
  • Experience supporting readiness assessments, training and enablement, go-live or release support, feedback collection, and post-implementation adoption activities.
  • Experience collecting, analyzing, and synthesizing stakeholder or end-user feedback into actionable themes and recommendations.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and produce high-quality deliverables with limited supervision within an established change strategy and governance structure.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Ability to work onsite as required for stakeholder engagements, workshops, training, leadership events, implementation activities, and other critical milestones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Agile, product-based, iterative, MVP, or phased implementations.
  • Experience with digital transformation, AI-enabled solutions, process transformation, or enterprise technology implementations.

job.description:
Scientist I

LOCATION: Cambridge, MA

SCHEDULE: Standard Business Hours

DURATION: 12-Month Contract (January 2027 – December 2027)

MAX PAY RATE: $46-51/hr



Job Responsibilities:

In this role, you will support exploratory discovery research within the Neurology Research Unit’s ALS Research Group, focusing on understanding the molecular and cellular mechanisms underlying amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Key responsibilities include:

  • Supporting early-stage discovery research focused on target identification and target validation in ALS and related neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Designing, executing, and analyzing molecular biology experiments to investigate genomic and proteomic alterations in ALS-related pathways.
  • Performing molecular biology assays, including quantitative PCR (qPCR), droplet digital PCR (ddPCR), gel electrophoresis, and western blotting.
  • Conducting protein analysis and proteomic studies using immunoprecipitation (IP), HTRF, AlphaLISA, and MSD assay platforms.
  • Performing mammalian cell culture, plasmid transfection, and viral transduction using human iPSC-derived neurons and established cell lines.
  • Supporting target validation studies through immunostaining, fluorescence microscopy, and quantitative image analysis.
  • Evaluating cellular co-localization, morphology, and phenotypic changes to characterize candidate therapeutic targets.
  • Generating high-quality, reproducible experimental data to support hypothesis-driven research and scientific decision-making.

Essential Duties and Job Functions:

  • Execute molecular and cellular biology experiments to investigate disease mechanisms and validate candidate therapeutic targets relevant to ALS.
  • Perform qPCR, ddPCR, gel electrophoresis, and western blot assays to assess gene and protein expression.
  • Conduct immunoprecipitation and protein quantification using HTRF, AlphaLISA, and MSD assay platforms.
  • Maintain mammalian cell cultures and perform plasmid transfection and viral transduction in iPSC-derived neurons and established cell lines.
  • Perform immunostaining, fluorescence microscopy, and quantitative image analysis to assess cellular localization, morphology, and phenotypic characteristics.
  • Assist with experimental design, assay development, optimization, troubleshooting, and validation.
  • Analyze experimental results and prepare preliminary data analyses, figures, and scientific summaries.
  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation of experimental methods, protocols, results, and observations.
  • Contribute to internal scientific presentations and communicate findings to research team members.
  • Collaborate with scientists to plan and execute hypothesis-driven studies supporting target identification and validation.
  • Support research investigating approaches to modulate the structural and functional properties of key targets.
  • Ensure all laboratory activities comply with established safety procedures, quality standards, and data integrity requirements.

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Strong foundation in molecular biology, cellular biology, genomics, and proteomics.
  • Hands-on experience with qPCR, ddPCR, western blotting, and protein analysis techniques.
  • Proficiency in mammalian cell culture, including experience with iPSC-derived neurons and/or established cell lines.
  • Experience with plasmid transfection and viral transduction techniques.
  • Familiarity with immunoprecipitation, protein quantification assays, and platforms such as HTRF, AlphaLISA, and MSD.
  • Experience with immunostaining, fluorescence microscopy, and quantitative image analysis.
  • Understanding of cellular co-localization, morphology, and phenotypic assessment methods.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to design experiments, troubleshoot technical challenges, and optimize laboratory assays.
  • Excellent experimental documentation practices and a strong commitment to data quality, reproducibility, and scientific rigor.
  • Ability to interpret experimental data and communicate findings through figures, summaries, and presentations.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple research activities and priorities.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with scientists and cross-functional research teams.
  • Knowledge of laboratory safety procedures and research quality standards.

Education & Experience:

  • PhD or Master's degree in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Neuroscience, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Training and technical expertise equivalent to advanced graduate-level study in a relevant field.
  • Strong hands-on laboratory experience in molecular and cellular biology.
  • Experience with genomic and proteomic assays, including gene expression analysis and protein quantification.
  • Experience with mammalian cell culture and iPSC-derived neuronal models is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with ALS biology, neurodegenerative disease mechanisms, or target validation research is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to generate reproducible experimental data, analyze results, and document scientific findings.

job.title: Senior Energy Storage Engineer – BESS
job.description:
Senior Energy Storage Engineer – Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)

Location: Remote – United States
Contract: 12 Months
Pay Rate: Up to $67.94 per hour
Travel: Approximately 25%

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Senior Energy Storage Engineer to support the engineering, design and execution of large-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and renewable energy infrastructure projects.

This is an opportunity to contribute to utility-scale energy storage developments, working alongside multidisciplinary engineering, construction and project management teams to deliver technically robust, safe and efficient energy storage solutions.

The successful candidate will bring strong technical engineering expertise, experience supporting complex energy projects and the ability to independently resolve design and engineering challenges throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Energy Storage Engineering & Design

  • Support the design, engineering and technical development of utility-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).

  • Provide engineering oversight for major equipment and components, including battery storage systems, power conversion equipment and associated electrical infrastructure.

  • Review engineering drawings, technical specifications and design documentation to identify discrepancies and recommend corrective actions.

  • Evaluate engineering studies, identify technical risks and develop practical solutions to improve system performance and reliability.

  • Support the integration of energy storage technologies with renewable generation assets, substations and associated electrical infrastructure.

Project Engineering & Delivery

  • Collaborate with project managers and cross-functional engineering teams to support projects from initial development through execution and completion.

  • Prepare technical scopes of work, engineering specifications and supporting documentation for equipment procurement and contractor agreements.

  • Monitor engineering milestones, project deliverables and technical risks to support successful project execution.

  • Coordinate with equipment manufacturers, suppliers and engineering consultants to ensure effective integration of major equipment.

  • Provide technical input into engineering decisions, design modifications and project improvement opportunities.

Technical Compliance & Safety

  • Support engineering compliance with applicable industry codes, electrical safety standards and energy storage requirements.

  • Review design considerations relating to lithium-ion battery storage, electrical safety, fire protection and system integration.

  • Contribute to permitting activities by identifying technical requirements, potential challenges and opportunities for site design improvements.

  • Support the development of engineering solutions that improve safety, constructability, reliability and operational performance.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Demonstrated experience in engineering design, project engineering or technical delivery within the renewable energy, electrical power or energy storage sectors.

  • Strong understanding of electrical engineering principles and complex energy infrastructure systems.

  • Experience reviewing technical drawings, engineering studies, equipment specifications and engineering deliverables.

  • Ability to independently manage specialised engineering tasks, investigate technical issues and recommend solutions.

  • Strong project coordination skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Willingness to travel approximately 25% for project-specific activities.

Preferred Qualifications & Technical Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in solar photovoltaic (PV) engineering and/or construction.

  • Experience with utility-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) or renewable energy infrastructure.

  • Technical expertise in one or more of the following:

    • Battery energy storage system design

    • Power electronics and power conversion systems (PCS)

    • Substation engineering and electrical infrastructure

    • Generation tie-in design and electrical integration

  • Familiarity with lithium-ion battery technologies, battery chemistries, DC/DC converters and associated equipment.

  • Knowledge of applicable battery energy storage and electrical safety standards, including UL 1973, UL 9540, UL 9540A, NFPA 855, NFPA 70E and the National Electrical Code (NEC).

  • Familiarity with relevant building and fire codes, including applicable IFC and IBC requirements.

  • Exposure to IEC 61215, IEC 61646 and IEC 61730 standards.

  • Experience coordinating technical requirements with equipment suppliers, engineering consultants and project stakeholders.

Why Apply?

  • Competitive hourly compensation: Up to $67.94 per hour.

  • Remote working: Work remotely with travel for project-specific engineering activities.

  • 12-month contract: Contribute to major utility-scale energy infrastructure projects.

  • Technically challenging work: Support advanced battery storage technologies and renewable energy integration.

  • Collaborative environment: Work alongside experienced engineering, construction and project delivery professionals.

Apply Today

If you are an experienced Energy Storage Engineer, BESS Engineer, Renewable Energy Engineer or Electrical Project Engineer looking to contribute to large-scale energy storage developments, we encourage you to apply.

We welcome applications from qualified professionals with relevant technical expertise and a strong interest in advancing energy storage infrastructure.

The Engineering Technician will join the client's Consumables Prototyping Services team. This team provides an organized platform for experimental design, prototyping, and process development.

The technician will conduct experiments, collect and analyze experimental data, and support troubleshooting and process improvement activities. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional project teams and internal partners to investigate technical issues, develop countermeasures, and help prevent recurring problems.

The ideal candidate is self-motivated, detail-oriented, punctual, and capable of working independently while contributing effectively to a team-oriented environment.

  • Independently manage moderately complex tasks with minimal supervision.
  • Perform experiments and collect, document, and analyze experimental data.
  • Learn and support multiple laboratory operations, processes, and technologies.
  • Apply hands-on technical skills to experimental execution and data collection.
  • Support troubleshooting, problem investigation, and corrective action development.
  • Plan and execute multiple concurrent activities as directed by the supervisor.
  • Track laboratory supply inventory and assist with laboratory equipment maintenance.

  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and internal stakeholders.
  • Acknowledge instructions, confirm understanding, and seek clarification when necessary.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and follow established laboratory procedures.
  • Support process improvement initiatives and prototyping activities.

  • Strong mathematical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Good documentation and data collection skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates typically have at least 1–2 years of relevant experience in a laboratory, engineering, manufacturing, or technical environment.

job.title: Underground Utility General Foreman
job.description:
Underground Utility General Foreman

Location: Indianapolis, IN
Employment Type: Permanent | Full-Time | On-Site
Base Salary: $62,400 annually ($30/hour equivalent) + Overtime Eligibility
Industry: Underground Utilities | Civil Construction | Infrastructure

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Underground Utility General Foreman to support an active underground utility construction project in Indianapolis, Indiana.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on construction leader with experience supervising underground utility crews, coordinating field operations and ensuring projects are completed safely, efficiently and to specification.

Working closely with the Site Superintendent, you will oversee daily construction activities, manage crew productivity and support the successful delivery of underground infrastructure projects.

Candidates with backgrounds in underground gas pipelines, utility installation, fibre optic infrastructure, trenching, excavation or directional drilling are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise and coordinate daily operations of underground utility construction crews, ensuring safe and productive field activities.

  • Oversee excavation, trenching, underground utility installation, backfilling and site restoration.

  • Coordinate labour, equipment, materials and resources to maintain project schedules and productivity.

  • Work closely with the Site Superintendent to monitor project progress, resolve field challenges and support operational requirements.

  • Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, company safety procedures and environmental standards.

  • Interpret construction drawings, blueprints and technical specifications to guide field operations.

  • Conduct regular site inspections to monitor workmanship, quality and safety.

  • Lead daily crew briefings and provide training, coaching and guidance to field personnel.

  • Coordinate with project managers, engineers, subcontractors and other construction stakeholders.

  • Maintain accurate daily reports covering progress, equipment usage, materials and safety activities.

  • Support the operation of excavators, trenchers, loaders and other heavy construction equipment when required.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5–7 years of experience in underground utility construction, civil infrastructure or a closely related construction environment.

  • At least 2 years of experience supervising construction crews or leading field operations.

  • Practical experience in underground utility installation, excavation, trenching or pipeline construction.

  • Strong understanding of construction safety requirements and OSHA regulations.

  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications and site plans.

  • Proven ability to coordinate field crews, equipment, materials and daily work schedules.

  • Strong leadership, communication and problem-solving skills.

  • Familiarity with heavy construction equipment and underground construction methods.

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • Valid driver's licence and ability to meet pre-employment screening requirements.

Preferred Experience

  • Underground gas pipeline or utility infrastructure construction.

  • Fibre optic or telecommunications underground installation.

  • Horizontal Directional Drilling (HDD) operations.

  • Water, sewer or stormwater utility installation.

  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification.

  • Experience supporting large-scale utility or infrastructure construction projects.

Salary & Benefits

Our client offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' health, financial security and long-term career development.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Annual base salary of $62,400 ($30/hour equivalent).

  • Overtime eligibility.

  • Potential annual performance bonus of approximately 10%, subject to confirmation.

  • $100 daily per diem may be available for eligible non-local employees.

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance, with employer contributions towards eligible premiums.

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match and immediate vesting.

  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with quarterly employer contributions for eligible participants.

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA).

  • Company-paid basic life and AD&D insurance.

  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage, subject to eligibility.

  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

  • Optional accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, pet insurance and legal assistance coverage.

  • Paid time off and holiday pay.

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan and tuition reimbursement opportunities.

Benefits are subject to eligibility, plan terms and company policies.

Work Location & Schedule

This is a full-time, site-based position supporting an underground utility construction project in Indianapolis, Indiana.

The project operates a six-day working schedule, with an extended weekend approximately every four weeks.

Local candidates from Indianapolis and surrounding communities are strongly encouraged to apply.

For eligible candidates travelling from outside the local area, a daily per diem of up to $100 may be available, subject to company policy and eligibility.

Apply Today

If you are an experienced Underground Utility Foreman, General Foreman or construction crew leader with a background in underground infrastructure, we would welcome your application.

Join a team delivering essential utility infrastructure projects and take the next step in your construction leadership career.

job.title: Test Lead
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Test Lead to drive quality assurance and testing across a strategic digital platform implementation within a financial services environment.

In this role, you will be responsible for defining and delivering the end-to-end testing strategy, ensuring that platforms, integrations, data flows and downstream reporting meet business, technical, security, regulatory and operational requirements.

Working closely with Product, Business, Architecture, Engineering, Data, Risk, Compliance, Information Security, Operations and external technology partners, you will establish a structured, risk-based testing approach that supports successful delivery and provides confidence in solution quality and go-live readiness.

This is an opportunity for a hands-on testing leader who combines strong technical expertise with stakeholder leadership, sound risk judgement and a commitment to delivering secure, reliable and customer-focused digital solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Stakeholder and Delivery Leadership

  • Act as the central quality lead across Product, Business, Architecture, Engineering, Data, Risk, Compliance, Information Security, Operations, and external vendor teams.
  • Manage dependencies across internal teams and external partners to maintain delivery momentum, testing quality, and release readiness.
  • Translate technical testing findings into clear business impacts, risk assessments, and actionable recommendations.
  • Facilitate test planning sessions, readiness reviews, delivery status updates, and risk discussions across project teams.
  • Coach analysts and delivery contributors in risk-based testing, defect prevention, evidence quality, and effective stakeholder communication.

Test Planning and Strategy

  • Develop and maintain the overall test strategy, master test plan, estimates, integrated test schedule, and resource requirements.
  • Establish risk-based test coverage, requirements traceability, quality metrics, quality gates, and entry and exit criteria.
  • Adapt testing strategies and approaches as business requirements, solution architecture, and delivery priorities evolve.
  • Identify and communicate quality risks, dependencies, and delivery blockers early, providing clear recommendations to support informed business decisions.
  • Ensure testing activities align with organisational quality standards, risk management frameworks, and applicable regulatory obligations.

End-to-End Testing and Integration Assurance

  • Lead the planning and execution of functional, integration, system, regression, end-to-end, user acceptance, and production-readiness testing.
  • Validate event-driven integrations across in-scope customer and operational touchpoints, including API and file-based exchanges, error handling, retries, duplicate prevention, sequencing, and reconciliation.
  • Verify the accurate and timely flow of data and customer feedback into downstream dashboards, reporting platforms, and business workflows.
  • Maintain end-to-end traceability from business and technical requirements through test scenarios, execution results, defect management, and acceptance evidence.
  • Validate cross-system processing to ensure transactions, customer interactions, and associated data are processed accurately and consistently.

Data Quality, Security and Privacy

  • Define and execute data validation testing across customer master data, operational interaction data, and platform outputs.
  • Validate data completeness, accuracy, timeliness, mapping, lineage, refresh cycles, and reconciliation across source and target systems.
  • Ensure appropriate role-based access, data masking, and privacy controls are implemented when handling personal, confidential, or restricted information in non-production environments.
  • Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Information Security, and Technology teams to validate controls and safeguard sensitive customer and business information.
  • Maintain appropriate testing evidence to support auditability, risk oversight, control assurance, and release approvals.

Test Automation and Non-Functional Assurance

  • Establish a pragmatic test automation strategy for repeatable API, integration, data, and critical user journey regression testing.
  • Develop and maintain reusable test assets, integrating automated checks into delivery pipelines where feasible.
  • Coordinate non-functional testing across performance, security, resilience, recovery, accessibility, browser and device compatibility, single sign-on (SSO), and access controls.
  • Partner with Architecture, Information Security, platform, and vendor teams to ensure non-functional requirements and technology controls are adequately tested and evidenced before go-live.

Defect and Environment Management

  • Lead defect triage, prioritisation, resolution tracking, and cross-system issue management, ensuring clear ownership and timely escalation.
  • Coordinate test environments, access, test accounts, stubs, mocks, and representative, privacy-safe test data.
  • Track testing progress, defect trends, dependencies, and outstanding issues, escalating risks that may affect delivery timelines or release quality.
  • Work collaboratively with delivery teams and vendors to resolve issues and maintain effective testing execution.

Experience and Skills

  • Proven experience leading testing and quality assurance for complex digital, SaaS, or multi-system implementations, ideally within financial services or another regulated environment
  • Experience with customer experience, feedback, or analytics platforms is highly regarded.
  • Strong SQL and data validation skills, including source-to-target mapping, data transformations, completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and reconciliation
  • Strong capability in developing and delivering test strategies, plans, estimates, schedules, and quality governance across the end-to-end delivery lifecycle.
  • Extensive hands-on experience across functional, integration, API, data, end-to-end, regression, and user acceptance testing.
  • Demonstrated experience testing event-driven integrations, REST APIs, batch and file-based interfaces, error handling, and cross-system data reconciliation..
  • Working knowledge of test automation frameworks and approaches for APIs, web applications, and data pipelines, with the ability to guide implementation and assess automated test results and code.
  • Understanding of identity and access management, including single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), role-based access controls, and SaaS user provisioning.
  • Sound understanding of data privacy, information security, operational risk, and control requirements within financial services environments.
  • Proven ability to coordinate external vendors, distributed delivery teams, test environments, test data, defect resolution, and release readiness.
  • Experience using Jira, Confluence, and test management and reporting tools such as Zephyr or equivalent platforms.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, communication, and planning skills, with the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear business risks, impacts, and actionable recommendations.
  • Experience delivering technology transformation or platform implementations across banking, insurance, wealth management, payments, or other financial services sectors is desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, establish clarity across multiple delivery teams, and maintain a consistent view of quality, risk, and release readiness.
  • Proven ability to coach and support team members, promote constructive challenge, and drive timely decision-making.
  • A proactive and collaborative approach to problem-solving, with a focus on developing simple, reusable, and sustainable testing practices.
  • Strong sense of accountability and ownership, balancing delivery outcomes and efficiency with appropriate quality, risk, and control standards.

job.title: Investment Process Analyst
job.description:
Investment Process Analyst – Transformation & Operating Model

We are seeking an experienced Investment Process Analyst to support a key transformation programme within a leading financial services organisation.

Working across a major Exposure Management & Rebalancing programme, you will play a pivotal role in understanding existing investment processes, defining future-state operating models and assessing the business impacts of proposed changes.

This is a broad, hands-on role suited to an investment professional who combines strong investment domain knowledge with experience in business process transformation, operating model design and change delivery. You will work closely with investment stakeholders and cross-functional teams to help translate an evolving solution into a practical, scalable operating model.

With the programme currently in the proof-of-concept stage, this is an opportunity to influence the direction of the initiative from an early stage, helping shape how the future state will operate across the wider business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyse current-state investment processes and identify opportunities for improvement across impacted business areas.
  • Develop future-state processes and operating models, defining roles, responsibilities, workflows and interactions between investment teams.
  • Map end-to-end process flows and identify operational dependencies arising from the proposed solution.
  • Conduct business impact assessments to understand how changes will affect teams, processes and existing ways of working.
  • Develop structured change plans to support the transition from current-state to future-state operations.
  • Prepare stakeholder and executive-level materials to communicate proposed changes, programme impacts and recommendations.
  • Support business readiness and training planning to ensure impacted teams are prepared for the new operating model.
  • Work collaboratively with investment, programme and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve ambiguity and drive deliverables forward.
  • Take ownership of emerging workstreams and deliverables, working autonomously in an evolving programme environment.

About You

You will bring a strong understanding of investment management and the ability to apply that knowledge to business process and operating model transformation.

You will ideally have:

  • Investment industry experience
  • Experience contributing to investment transformation initiatives, particularly those involving business processes, operating models or changes to investment operations.
  • A proven ability to document current-state processes and design future-state processes and target operating models.
  • Experience assessing business impacts across multiple teams and translating these into practical change and implementation plans.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the confidence to communicate complex operational changes clearly to both business teams and senior stakeholders.
  • A proactive, self-sufficient approach, with the ability to take ownership of ambiguous deliverables and determine the best way forward.
  • The flexibility to work across investment analysis, process design, operating model development and change-related activities as required.

Experience in exposure management, portfolio rebalancing, unit pricing or investment platforms such as Matrix would be advantageous, but is not essential.

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to join a significant investment transformation initiative at an early stage, with genuine scope to influence future-state processes and operating models.

You will work across a broad range of deliverables, engage with stakeholders across the investment function and play a key role in shaping the operational impacts of a developing solution.

If you are an investment professional who enjoys working across disciplines, solving complex business problems and delivering practical outcomes, we would welcome a conversation.

Interested? Apply now or get in touch to discuss the opportunity in more detail.

job.description:

LOCATION: Hayward, CA (Onsite)

SCHEDULE: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM

DURATION: 14-Month Contract

PAY: 63-68 USD per hour



Job Responsibilities:

In this role, you will lead engineering activities to qualify supplier relocations for DNA sequencing systems. You will ensure that mechanical components, assemblies, and manufacturing processes continue to meet the required design, quality, reliability, and performance standards when production moves to a new supplier or manufacturing location.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading supplier-relocation projects and developing qualification plans, requirements, schedules, budgets, and risk assessments.
  • Reviewing engineering drawings, specifications, bills of materials (BOMs), manufacturing processes, tooling, and inspection methods.
  • Working with suppliers to collect technical documentation, samples, inspection records, material certifications, and validation evidence.
  • Developing and executing verification and validation plans, dimensional inspections, functional testing, and process-capability studies.
  • Identifying and resolving supplier quality issues, qualification failures, and manufacturing-related problems.
  • Collaborating with Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Regulatory, and Process Engineering teams to obtain necessary approvals.
  • Managing engineering change control, supplier approvals, documentation updates, and release-to-manufacturing activities.
  • Maintaining accurate qualification records and ensuring projects meet established timelines and budgets.

Essential Duties and Job Functions:

  • Assess the technical requirements involved in transferring manufacturing from one supplier or location to another.
  • Evaluate mechanical parts, assemblies, materials, and manufacturing processes to identify potential risks and technical gaps.
  • Review engineering drawings and apply Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) principles to ensure components meet design specifications.
  • Develop qualification requirements based on product performance, material properties, dimensional tolerances, and manufacturing capabilities.
  • Coordinate with suppliers to obtain qualification samples, material certifications, inspection results, and supporting documentation.
  • Plan and conduct verification and validation activities to confirm that relocated parts and processes meet established requirements.
  • Perform or coordinate dimensional and functional testing, measurement-system analysis, and process-capability studies.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions for failed qualifications, supplier deviations, and technical issues.
  • Review qualification results with internal stakeholders and secure the required technical and quality approvals.
  • Manage engineering changes, supplier qualification documentation, part approvals, and lifecycle-management reviews.
  • Ensure qualified components and manufacturing processes are approved and ready for production.
  • Track project progress, manage competing priorities, communicate risks, and implement recovery plans when necessary.
  • Prepare clear technical reports and maintain complete, accurate engineering records.

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of mechanical engineering principles, mechanical design, and precision assemblies.
  • Proficiency in SolidWorks, engineering drawings, and GD&T.
  • Understanding of materials, manufacturing methods, fabrication processes, tooling, and inspection techniques.
  • Knowledge of supplier qualification, manufacturing transfers, sustaining engineering, and verification and validation.
  • Ability to evaluate dimensional variation, material properties, and process capability in relation to product performance.
  • Experience with root-cause analysis, problem-solving, and corrective and preventive actions.
  • Familiarity with measurement-system analysis, dimensional inspection, functional testing, and process-capability studies.
  • Strong project management skills, including scheduling, risk management, budgeting, and documentation.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with suppliers and cross-functional engineering, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain teams.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple supplier-relocation projects and meet critical deadlines.
  • Familiarity with regulated manufacturing environments and engineering change-control processes.

Education & Experience:

  • Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering with at least 5 years of relevant experience, or
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering with at least 8 years of relevant experience.
  • Experience in sustaining engineering, supplier quality, part qualification, or manufacturing transfer.
  • Experience in life sciences, medical devices, or another regulated industry preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with mechanical design, SolidWorks, GD&T, precision assemblies, materials, and manufacturing processes.
  • Experience leading supplier technical investigations, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Experience preparing engineering documentation and managing qualification activities through final approval.
  • Experience working with FDA-regulated products is a plus.
  • Previous should-cost analysis experience is a plus.
