job.title: Fire Safety Engineer
job.description:
FIRE SAFETY SUBJECT MATTER EXPERT – BATTERY ENERGY STORAGE SYSTEMS (BESS)

LOCATION: Remote

SCHEDULE: Standard

DURATION: 12-Month Contract

PAY: $37-42/hr



Job Responsibilities:

In this role, you will serve as a Fire Safety Subject Matter Expert for utility-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). You will help ensure battery storage projects are designed, installed, and operated safely by reviewing fire safety systems, assessing potential hazards, and ensuring compliance with applicable codes and standards.




Key responsibilities include:

  • Reviewing UL 9540A test reports to evaluate battery fire behavior and potential hazards at cell, module, unit, and installation levels.
  • Evaluating and providing guidance on fire protection systems and safety designs for BESS manufacturers and projects.
  • Ensuring compliance with applicable UL standards, NFPA codes, International Fire Code (IFC), and other relevant safety requirements.
  • Overseeing project safety analyses, including Hazard Mitigation Analysis (HMA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), heat flux analysis, and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations.
  • Building relationships with Fire Marshals, fire departments, first responders, regulatory authorities, and local communities.
  • Educating emergency responders and local authorities about BESS fire hazards, safety systems, and emergency response procedures.
  • Supporting consistent fire safety standards, documentation, and communication across all project locations.
  • Participating in industry task groups and technical committees to improve BESS safety codes and standards.
  • Developing standardized templates and reporting guidelines for third-party safety assessments and supplier evaluations.

Essential Duties and Job Functions:

  • Review and assess UL 9540A test reports to understand thermal runaway, fire propagation, and associated hazards.
  • Provide technical recommendations and guidance on BESS fire safety system designs.
  • Review project- and product-level designs to verify compliance with applicable fire safety codes and standards.
  • Evaluate hazard mitigation strategies and fire safety analyses to ensure risks are appropriately addressed.
  • Review heat flux calculations and CFD simulation results to understand potential fire spread and thermal impacts.
  • Coordinate with engineering teams, manufacturers, suppliers, and project stakeholders to resolve fire safety concerns.
  • Develop and deliver presentations and educational sessions for firefighters, first responders, Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs), Public Utility Commissions (PUCs), and community representatives.
  • Explain BESS hazards, fire protection systems, system operating sequences, and Emergency Response Plans (ERPs) and Emergency Operations Plans (EOPs).
  • Travel to local jurisdictions to support stakeholder meetings, emergency preparedness, and public safety education.
  • Establish standardized fire safety guidance and communication practices across the organization.
  • Participate in industry committees to support the development and improvement of BESS fire safety codes and standards.
  • Create standardized templates for third-party analyses and technical reports to improve consistency, efficiency, and supplier onboarding.

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Strong understanding of fire safety engineering and utility-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems.
  • Knowledge of battery fire hazards, thermal runaway, fire propagation, and hazard mitigation strategies.
  • Experience reviewing UL 9540A test reports and BESS fire protection system designs.
  • Familiarity with applicable UL standards, NFPA codes, International Fire Code (IFC), and other relevant regulations.
  • Knowledge of HMA, FMEA, heat flux analysis, and CFD simulations.
  • Strong technical analysis, problem-solving, and risk assessment skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical fire safety concepts to nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering teams, manufacturers, suppliers, fire departments, and regulatory authorities.
  • Strong documentation, reporting, and standardization skills.
  • Ability to develop safety procedures, technical guidelines, and emergency response materials.
  • Willingness to travel locally for stakeholder engagement, training, and public safety education.

Education & Experience:

  • Relevant education or professional experience in Fire Protection Engineering, Fire Science, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience with fire safety assessments and battery energy storage systems preferred.
  • Experience reviewing UL 9540A test reports and evaluating BESS fire protection designs.
  • Familiarity with NFPA codes, IFC requirements, and applicable fire safety standards.
  • Experience with hazard analysis, FMEA, heat flux analysis, and CFD modeling preferred.
  • Experience working with fire departments, first responders, regulatory authorities, or other public safety stakeholders is an advantage.

job.title: Financial Crime Data Engineering Lead (snowflake, dbt)
job.description:
I'm looking for a technically strong Financial Crime Data Lead to take ownership of the data engineering capability supporting financial crime operations within a leading UK financial services organisation.

Deep, hands-on expertise in both Snowflake and dbt is absolutely essential for this position. This isn't a purely strategic or people management role. I'm looking for someone who has significant experience designing, building and optimising production data platforms using both technologies, and who can set the technical direction whilst remaining close to the engineering.

The role offers the opportunity to build a trusted financial crime data foundation, bringing together information across transaction monitoring, screening, onboarding, CRM and operational systems to improve data quality, regulatory controls, reporting and future AI capabilities

The role

You'll take technical ownership of the financial crime data platform, shaping its architecture, engineering standards and delivery whilst leading a focused data engineering capability.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Snowflake architecture and engineering: Own the design, implementation and optimisation of Snowflake environments, including warehouse architecture, schema design, performance tuning, security, access controls and cost optimisation.
  • dbt development and architecture: Establish and develop robust dbt transformation frameworks, including complex SQL models, incremental processing, macros, testing, documentation, lineage and CI/CD integration.
  • Hands-on data engineering: Design and build production-grade SQL and Python pipelines, integrating data from multiple internal and external platforms.
  • Data modelling: Develop scalable data models covering clients, entities, transactions, alerts, screening outcomes, risk ratings, investigations and audit records.
  • Data quality and governance: Establish automated testing, reconciliation, data lineage, monitoring and governance controls across sensitive financial crime datasets.
  • Technical leadership: Define engineering standards, review architectural decisions, mentor engineers and ensure delivery follows strong software engineering practices.
  • Financial crime integration: Bring together data from AML, KYC, transaction monitoring, screening, CRM and other operational systems.
  • AI and automation: Build reliable, well-governed datasets that support future machine learning, anomaly detection, alert optimisation and investigation automation.

What I'm looking for

The most important requirement is someone with genuine technical depth across Snowflake and dbt, backed by strong SQL/Python engineering and experience leading data platform delivery.

Essential experience:

  • Extensive, hands-on Snowflake engineering experience, including architecture, data modelling, performance optimisation, warehouse management, security and cost control.
  • Advanced dbt expertise, having designed and developed production transformation frameworks rather than simply worked with existing models.
  • Strong SQL skills, including complex transformations, query optimisation, data quality checks, reconciliation and scalable modelling techniques.
  • Strong Python engineering capabilities for pipelines, automation, API integrations, testing and reusable data processing.
  • Experience designing and delivering modern cloud data platforms in complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of data engineering best practices, including Git, CI/CD, automated testing, observability and production support.
  • Previous experience leading engineers, setting technical standards and taking ownership of architecture and delivery.
  • Experience working with sensitive, governed data in financial services or another highly regulated environment.

Particularly interesting experience:

  • Financial crime, AML, KYC, sanctions screening or transaction monitoring data.
  • Integrating financial crime platforms, CRM systems and third-party vendor APIs.
  • Data Vault, dimensional modelling or complex entity resolution.
  • Building data foundations for machine learning, anomaly detection or GenAI applications.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Airflow or similar orchestration technologies.

Why consider it?

This is an opportunity to take genuine technical ownership of an important data engineering capability, rather than inherit an established platform with limited scope to influence its direction.

You'll help shape how financial crime data is structured, integrated, governed and consumed across the organisation, with the opportunity to introduce engineering standards, improve operational processes and enable future automation and AI use cases.

The role offers a combination of hands-on technical challenges, architectural ownership, leadership responsibilities and direct exposure to senior business and technology stakeholders.

Package: Up to £120,000 base salary, plus bonus, excellent pension and wider benefits.

Location: London, Glasgow or Liverpool, with hybrid working. London-based employees attend the office 2–3 days per week.

If you're a senior Data Engineer, Principal Data Engineer or Data Engineering Lead with substantial Snowflake and dbt experience, and you're interested in taking ownership of a business-critical data platform, I'd be keen to have a conversation.

job.title: Planner
job.description:
Job Description

Workface Planner, Industrial EPC Construction
Location: Texas (remote or hybrid, with about 40% travel to project sites in Texas)

About the Company
Hydrogen Group is partnering with one of the largest direct-hire industrial construction and EPC contractors in the U.S. They self-perform turnkey projects across power generation, refining, gas processing, chemical and petrochemical, hydrogen, and heavy industrial markets, from groundbreaking through commissioning and startup. Because they self-perform, planning directly supports their own crews. They’re growing quickly and adding an experienced Workface Planner to support active projects across Texas.

The Role
The Workface Planner makes sure field crews have everything they need before work starts: approved drawings, materials, tools, equipment, scaffold, access, permits, and safety and quality requirements. You’ll work directly with superintendents, general foremen, field engineering, project controls, procurement, and quality to build executable work packages, clear constraints, and keep work moving from release through closeout.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and maintain Construction Work Packages (CWPs) and Installation Work Packages (IWPs) in line with AWP and workface planning processes
  • Break scope down by area, discipline, system, or construction sequence using drawings, specifications, P&IDs, isometrics, and general arrangements
  • Support the 6-week lookahead, 3-week lookahead, and weekly work plan
  • Align packages with schedule activities, quantities, phase codes, and progress rules alongside Project Controls
  • Confirm materials are identified, ordered, received, and staged, and that drawings and documents are current
  • Identify, track, and escalate constraints, and maintain package logs, constraint logs, and readiness checklists
  • Run readiness reviews and prepare packages for field release
  • Track package progress, field feedback, and remaining work, and support closeout including QC documentation and redlines
  • Find opportunities to improve sequencing, readiness, and workflow on active projects

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years in industrial construction, EPC, power generation, LNG, refining, petrochemical, data center, or heavy industrial work
  • Hands-on workface planning, AWP, or IWP development experience, ideally on the contractor side
  • Background in construction planning, field engineering, project controls, or material coordination
  • Ability to read construction drawings, P&IDs, isometrics, and discipline-specific documents
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, short-interval planning, and field execution
  • Strong Excel skills; P6 or MS Project, Bluebeam, and Procore, ACC, or similar a plus
  • Degree in Construction Management or Engineering preferred; equivalent field experience considered

Preferred

  • Power generation or combined cycle experience (LNG and petrochemical also highly valued)
  • AWP software experience (ConstructSim, O3, or similar)
  • Craft or field supervision background

Benefits

  • Weekly pay
  • Medical, dental, vision, and short- and long-term disability
  • 401(k) with company match, vested on day one
  • Employee stock purchase plan
  • Pet and legal assistance coverage
  • Award-winning safety programs

Interested? Apply directly or reach out to Leah Roberts at leahroberts@hydrogengroup.com.

job.title: GSE Combination Welder III
job.description:
GSE Combination Welder

Hydrogen Group is hiring on behalf of a confidential client in the aerospace and space technology industry for a GSE Combination Welder to support the fabrication, assembly, and modification of ground support equipment and flight-grade stainless steel components.

This position will work on a variety of projects, including equipment used for research and development testing, launch site infrastructure, and production tooling. The successful candidate will interpret engineering drawings, perform multiple welding processes, and collaborate with engineering, design, and operations teams to ensure fabricated components meet quality and performance standards.

Location: Briggs, TX, just north of Austin/Cedar Park.

Key Responsibilities

  • Complete welding and fabrication assignments in accordance with established procedures, technical specifications, and quality standards.

  • Weld aluminum and steel structures, piping, and assemblies using applicable processes, including TIG, MIG, and stick welding.

  • Interpret engineering blueprints and technical drawings to plan layouts, prepare materials, and complete welds to specified dimensions and tolerances.

  • Review piping and instrumentation diagrams, shop drawings, and related documentation to support equipment installation, troubleshooting, and repairs.

  • Install and modify tubing, piping, and conduit associated with fluid systems and equipment upgrades.

  • Use precision measuring instruments and mechanical tools, including torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, plug gauges, and pin gauges, to verify dimensions, identify issues, and maintain equipment to required standards.

  • Conduct safety inspections and operate equipment such as forklifts and boom lifts when needed.

  • Maintain a clean, organized work area and contribute to ongoing site improvement efforts.

  • Travel to launch facilities as required to support project and program needs.

Basic Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • At least 3 years of relevant welding experience.

  • Hands-on experience with MIG, TIG, stick, and flux-core welding processes.

  • Background in both structural and pipe welding.

  • Understanding of heat input, heat distribution, and thermal management techniques used to minimize distortion during welding.

  • Familiarity with standard fabrication shop practices, including layout, drilling, sawing, and grinding.

  • Experience operating forklifts, cranes, or other industrial machinery; lifting and rigging experience is preferred.

  • Availability to work overtime and weekends as business needs require.

  • Ability to lift at least 50 pounds without assistance.

  • Ability to bend, stoop, crawl, work in confined or restricted spaces, and perform tasks on elevated structures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5 or more years of relevant welding experience.

  • Experience fabricating and welding stainless steel cryogenic piping systems.

  • Strong mechanical troubleshooting skills, including the ability to identify equipment issues, determine appropriate solutions, and resolve problems efficiently.

Required Weld Test

Candidates should be prepared to complete the following welding assessments:

TIG Welding

  • 2-inch Schedule 10 stainless steel pipe in the 6G position.

  • 2-inch Schedule 160 stainless steel pipe in the 6G position.

Stick / Flux-Core Welding

  • Carbon steel tee plate weld in vertical and overhead positions using stick welding.

  • Carbon steel tee plate weld in vertical and overhead positions using flux-core welding.

Our client’s Engineering & Construction (E&C) Business Unit is seeking a Principal Engineer – Substation to own assigned substation projects from early-stage conception through construction and commissioning. You will provide technical oversight of external engineers of record, partner with project management, supply chain, transmission, and legal stakeholders, and make sure each substation is designed and built safely, on budget, and in compliance with interconnection requirements and industry standards. Job Responsibilities: In this role, you will manage and support a variety of projects within the Engineering & Construction department. Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading engineering for assigned substation projects across both the Early Stage and Execution phases
  • Providing technical oversight of external engineers of record (EOR) to ensure design compliance
  • Sourcing and managing engineering, geotechnical, survey, and construction services
  • Representing E&C’s internal and external interests with project stakeholders and management

Essential Job Duties and Job Functions:

  • Support all assigned substation projects from conception (Early Stage) through construction and commissioning (Execution)
  • In the conceptual phase, work with the Early-Stage Project Manager to support engineering requirements and scope with the Development Group
  • Train, perform due diligence on, and provide technical oversight of external EORs to ensure compliance with generation interconnection agreements, scope of work documents, project specifications, site-specific design requirements, IEEE, NESC, ASCE, and all other applicable codes and standards
  • Secure engineering consulting resources from a list of approved suppliers by developing scopes of work, securing bids, evaluating, and awarding work through the Integrated Supply Chain (ISC) Group
  • Competitively source, select, and contract geotechnical, survey, engineering, and construction services, and support the E&C Cost Estimating Team with scope assumptions
  • Coordinate with project stakeholders to develop and secure a substation site, and support engineering updates, data, and permits necessary to design and build the substation
  • Coordinate with other groups to ensure assigned E&C substation projects succeed, including presenting progress, issues, and risk mitigation to various levels of management
  • Support Transmission Services in reviewing interconnection documentation, including system impact studies, facility studies, reactive and harmonic studies, and interconnection agreements
  • Ensure Transmission Owner requirements and E&C engineering design are consistent and compliant with all ISO requirements, and that they are incorporated into the project design
  • Communicate frequently with transmission owners, operators, and ISOs so deliverables meet off-taker requirements and are timely and accurate
  • Manage all long-lead major material orders to minimize schedule delays and budget overruns
  • Assist ISC with substation project SOW creation, review, approval, and preparation of shopping carts for engineering services and materials
  • Support E&C Estimating with template updates based on project feedback, technical support, and scope modifications
  • Work collaboratively with project engineering resources across disciplines to determine priorities, work plans, and lines of demarcation
  • Ensure projects are implemented efficiently, cost-effectively, and safely in accordance with department processes, procedures, industry standards, and policies
  • Support project commissioning activities to meet corporate objectives
  • Support Legal with regulatory filings, depositions, and/or hearings
  • Collaborate with component OEMs to enhance and adapt their designs to better integrate with the company’s design philosophies

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Substation design and engineering for high-voltage projects
  • Working knowledge of IEEE, NESC, ASCE, and other applicable industry codes and standards
  • Familiarity with generation interconnection agreements and ISO/transmission owner requirements, including system impact, facility, reactive, and harmonic studies
  • Project engineering and/or project management skills, with a strong bias for action
  • Vendor and consultant sourcing, including SOW development, bid evaluation, and award
  • Management of long-lead material orders against schedule and budget
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to brief management and work with external transmission owners, operators, and ISOs
  • Ability to collaborate across engineering disciplines, OEMs, supply chain, estimating, and legal

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Civil/Structural Engineering preferred
  • 7+ years of experience in substation design and engineering of high-voltage substation projects highly preferred
  • Project engineering and/or project management experience
  • PMP and/or P.E. in a related discipline is a plus

Schedule: Standard

Our client, a medical device organization, is seeking a Senior Engineer, R&D Sustainment to support the lifecycle management of on-market Class III implantable medical devices. Working alongside Quality and Manufacturing teams, you will investigate field and manufacturing issues, implement design and process improvements, and support engineering change assessments. Your work will help ensure continued product safety, performance, reliability, manufacturability, and regulatory compliance for devices that improve outcomes for patients with heart failure.




Job Responsibilities:

In this role, you will manage and support a variety of projects within the R&D Engineering department, focused on the post-market sustainment of Class III implantable devices. Key responsibilities include:




Essential Job Duties and Job Functions:

  • Issue Resolution and Root Cause Investigation: Lead investigations into device field issues by analyzing product performance data, customer feedback, and failure reports. Define and execute engineering studies and testing to determine root cause and support effective actions that minimize device downtime and customer impact.
  • Design and Process Improvement: Partner with R&D and Manufacturing to identify and lead design changes and process improvements that enhance device reliability, performance, and manufacturability.
  • Product Performance Monitoring: Monitor device performance and quality metrics, and develop and execute plans to address deviations from expected performance.
  • Design Changes and Change Control: Lead design and process changes for on-market devices, including design impact assessments, documentation, requirements and specification updates, verification planning, change control implementation, and assessment of labeling and risk impacts.
  • Risk Management: Lead updates to design FMEAs, hazard analyses, and risk management files. Evaluate whether issues or changes introduce new hazards, affect existing risk controls, or require additional mitigation, verification, or validation.
  • Verification and Validation (V&V): Develop, review, and execute test plans, protocols, reports, and test methods to support product changes, manufacturing improvements, complaint investigations, CAPAs, and regulatory responses. Analyze results using appropriate engineering and statistical methods to ensure objective evidence supports design change decisions.
  • Documentation and Compliance: Maintain accurate, comprehensive records of engineering changes, investigations, technical reports, test records, risk documentation, and change control. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company standards, and collaborate with Quality and Regulatory on regulatory requests.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Development, suppliers, and other engineering teams to support product lifecycle management.
  • Assign R&D support tasks and train, coach, and guide lower-level employees on routine procedures.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, FDA quality management system regulations, and applicable medical device regulatory expectations
  • Experience developing or executing verification and validation protocols, engineering test methods, and technical reports
  • Working knowledge of medical device design controls, change control, CAPA, complaint investigations, and risk management
  • Proficiency in engineering software and statistical tools for design and data analysis, in particular Python, Minitab, and Excel
  • Experience with CAD, engineering specifications, tolerance analysis, and hardware design documentation (preferred)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical rationale and present findings to cross-functional stakeholders
  • Solid problem-solving, organizational, analytical, and critical thinking skills
  • Attention to detail and commitment to high-quality documentation
  • Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, fast-paced, regulated environment while managing multiple priorities
  • Adherence to all company rules and requirements, including Environmental Health & Safety rules, and use of appropriate control measures to prevent injury and protect the environment

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or a Scientific field with 4 years of experience, OR Master’s Degree or equivalent in Engineering or a Scientific field with 3 years of experience, OR Ph.D. or equivalent in Engineering or a Scientific field
  • Experience supporting on-market medical devices, preferably Class III implantable or electromechanical devices (preferred)

job.title: Interconnection Coordinator – Energy Projects
job.description:
Interconnection Coordinator – Energy Projects

Location: Remote – United States (travel approximately twice per quarter)

Contract: 12 Months

Pay Rate: $37.47 per hour

Schedule: Standard Office Hours

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a detail-oriented Interconnection Coordinator to support the delivery of major energy infrastructure and power generation projects across the United States.

This opportunity will involve coordinating contractual deliverables associated with Power Purchase Agreements (PPA), Interconnection Agreements (IA), and Generator Interconnection Agreements (GIA), ensuring critical project obligations are documented, tracked and completed within agreed deadlines.

Working closely with corporate project teams, construction personnel and transmission stakeholders, you will play an important role in supporting project compliance, reporting and successful interconnection activities.

This position would suit someone with experience in utility project coordination, contract administration, project controls or infrastructure project management.

Key Responsibilities

Interconnection & Contract Coordination

  • Review Power Purchase Agreements (PPA) and Interconnection Agreements (IA) to identify contractual requirements, project obligations and submission deadlines.

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive registers of contractual deliverables for review by Interconnection Specialists.

  • Coordinate documentation and submissions with Transmission Owners, Transmission Operators and PPA stakeholders.

  • Monitor interconnection milestones and ensure contractual deliverables remain aligned with project schedules.

Project Controls & Reporting

  • Import, maintain and update contractual deliverables within project controls systems.

  • Track submission deadlines, outstanding actions and critical-path activities associated with interconnection requirements.

  • Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports highlighting deliverable status, upcoming milestones and potential schedule risks.

  • Support accurate project documentation, reporting and compliance tracking.

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Collaborate with construction site teams, corporate project personnel and Transmission Services.

  • Participate in regular Generator Interconnection Agreement (GIA) dashboard meetings.

  • Prepare meeting materials, maintain action logs and follow up on outstanding deliverables.

  • Establish effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support timely project execution.

Systems & Process Management

  • Support the administration of contractual deliverables within Oracle Primavera Unifier or comparable project controls platforms.

  • Assist with agreement-related task imports, system updates and reporting improvements.

  • Maintain accurate project records and contribute to continuous improvement of interconnection tracking processes.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience in project coordination, contract administration, project controls or a related discipline.

  • Ability to interpret contractual documentation and identify deliverables, obligations and critical deadlines.

  • Strong understanding of contract terminology and document management processes.

  • Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive project deliverables.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • High attention to detail and accuracy in reporting and documentation.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritise workloads and meet project deadlines.

  • Proficiency with project tracking tools, reporting systems and Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Experience

  • Previous experience supporting utilities, renewable energy, power generation, transmission or large-scale infrastructure projects.

  • Familiarity with Power Purchase Agreements (PPA), Interconnection Agreements (IA) or Generator Interconnection Agreements (GIA).

  • Experience working with Transmission Owners, Transmission Operators or utility interconnection teams.

  • Working knowledge of Oracle Primavera Unifier or similar project controls software.

  • Experience maintaining contractual deliverable registers, project dashboards and critical milestone reporting.

Contract Details

  • Pay: $37.47 per hour

  • Duration: Initial 12-month contract

  • Location: Remote within the United States

  • Travel: Approximately twice per quarter to project sites or corporate offices

  • Working Hours: Standard business hours

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to support major US energy infrastructure projects while gaining exposure to utility interconnection processes, transmission stakeholders and large-scale power generation developments.

The role offers remote working, varied project responsibilities and the opportunity to work alongside experienced energy and infrastructure professionals.

Apply today to learn more about this Interconnection Coordinator opportunity.

job.title: Application Security Engineer
job.description:
We're looking for an Application Security Engineer to join the Software Engineering group at our financial services client in Sydney. Your job is to build on an already developed engineering practice and then begin to look at data, investment and digital engineering teams. You’ll make sure security findings are prioritised by real risk, fixed, and tracked until the fix is verified.

What you’ll be doing

  • Reviewing results from application security tools covering SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets, API, container and infrastructure-as-code scanning, confirming genuine impact and weeding out false positives, duplicates and recurring root causes
  • Ranking findings by severity, exploitability, how critical and exposed the asset is, and the business context, in line with the vulnerability management process
  • Giving engineers clear, practical fix guidance, and keeping a traceable record from each finding to its remediation ticket, owner, due date, exception and closure evidence
  • Owning secure SDLC controls from design through to ongoing maintenance, including the control requirements, implementation guidance, evidence expectations and reviews of whether the controls work
  • Overseeing GitHub security and related integrations: repository baselines, access reviews, branch protection, pull-request rules, code ownership, secrets protection, scanning, status checks, ticketing and exception handling
  • Reporting on the health, risk and trends of the remediation backlog, escalating overdue or blocked items, verifying completed fixes, keeping security records up to date, and managing risk exemptions from approval through to review or expiry

What you’ll bring

  • Strong analytical skills and a track record of triaging and prioritising application security findings
  • Working knowledge of SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets, API, container and infrastructure-as-code scanning, plus OWASP Top 10, API Security Top 10, common CWEs and software supply-chain risks
  • Experience defining, implementing and assessing secure SDLC controls across the full lifecycle
  • The ability to turn technical findings into clear, actionable guidance for engineering teams
  • Experience with vulnerability management workflows, ticketing, backlog management, reporting and evidence-based closure
  • Deep GitHub security knowledge, including repository governance, access models, branch protection, pull-request controls, code ownership, GitHub’s security features and application security integrations
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, written communication and follow-through

job.title: Cloud Security Engineer
job.description:
We’re looking for a hands-on, Cloud Security Engineer to strengthen the security of our clients AWS platforms. You’ll work alongside platform and application teams, fixing the highest-risk issues first and shaping the guardrails that stop the same problems coming back.

What you’ll be doing

  • Fixing cloud security issues directly, including vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, risky identity setups and control gaps raised through security tooling and the vulnerability management process
  • Working with the cloud platform team and workload owners to roll out changes, then confirming each fix has been applied properly and the finding is genuinely closed
  • Automating recurring fixes and control checks, and hardening the infrastructure delivery pipeline with secure pipeline templates, CloudFormation validation, secrets protection, approval steps and security gates

  • Supporting day-to-day security operations through telemetry, incident response, standards, playbooks and audit
  • Owning the exemption process for cloud security risks: assessing the remaining risk, recording the business reason and compensating controls, getting sign-off, and tracking each exemption until it is reviewed or expires

What you’ll bring

  • Deep AWS security and engineering knowledge across identity and access management, network security, encryption, secrets management, logging and workload protection
  • Python scripting skills, using AWS APIs to automate fixes and check that controls are working
  • Hands-on experience with Git, CNAPP/CSPM tools, AWS Control Tower (or similar), SIEM integration and vulnerability management
  • Experience building secure CI/CD pipelines for cloud infrastructure, including GitHub Actions or a comparable tool, automated testing, secrets handling, approval controls and deployment guardrails
  • CloudFormation experience (essential)
  • Working knowledge of NIST, ISO 27001, the ASD Essential Eight and APRA CPS 234

Nice to have

  • Sceptre, GCP and Azure experience
  • A relevant AWS security certification

If you would like to discuss this role further, please apply and we'll contact you within 24 hours to discuss.

Good luck!!

job.description:
RANSOMWARE RECOVERY & CYBER VAULT ADMINISTRATOR

LOCATION: Remote (Must be local to Southern California and available to report to the office as needed)

SCHEDULE: Full-time

DURATION: 6 months

PAY: 77-82 USD per hour



Job Responsibilities:

In this role, you will administer and support the organization's ransomware recovery and cyber vault infrastructure, ensuring critical enterprise data is protected and recoverable in the event of a cyber incident. Key responsibilities include:

  • Administering and maintaining Dell Cyber Recovery Vault environments and supporting infrastructure.
  • Managing secure replication of backup data into isolated recovery environments.
  • Monitoring vault health, replication status, storage capacity, and recovery readiness.
  • Administering Dell Data Domain appliances, including configuration, maintenance, upgrades, replication, and retention management.
  • Administering Dell CyberSense, including configuring scans and policies, monitoring ransomware detection analytics, and investigating anomalies.
  • Supporting ransomware recovery processes, disaster recovery exercises, and recovery validation activities.
  • Performing backup verification, restore testing, and recovery readiness assessments.
  • Implementing secure and immutable backup configurations and maintaining security hardening standards.
  • Collaborating with cybersecurity, infrastructure, storage, database, and application teams to support recovery operations.
  • Maintaining operational documentation, reporting, and recovery procedures.
  • Supporting compliance requirements, security reviews, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Essential Duties and Job Functions:

  • Manage day-to-day administration of Dell Cyber Recovery Vault infrastructure and ensure the environment remains secure and operational.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot Dell Data Domain systems, including backup failures, replication issues, system performance, deduplication efficiency, and capacity utilization.
  • Administer Dell CyberSense and review analytics reports to identify potential ransomware activity, suspicious data changes, and indicators of data corruption.
  • Investigate anomalies and coordinate with cybersecurity teams to assess potential threats and determine appropriate recovery actions.
  • Validate the integrity and recoverability of protected data through regular testing and recovery exercises.
  • Support cyber incident response and participate in ransomware recovery activities as needed.
  • Maintain backup retention policies, replication configurations, access controls, and immutable storage settings.
  • Ensure cyber recovery procedures align with business continuity, disaster recovery, security, and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, dashboards, and recovery readiness reports.
  • Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, recovery efficiency, and ransomware resilience.
  • Work independently, take ownership of assigned tasks, and drive them through completion with minimal supervision.
  • Collaborate with the Senior Manager of the Data Recovery team and other technical stakeholders to support operational priorities.

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with Dell CyberSense and Dell Cyber Recovery Vault technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of Dell Data Domain administration, including replication, retention policies, storage management, troubleshooting, and system maintenance.
  • Understanding of ransomware recovery strategies, cyber resilience, immutable backups, and isolated or air-gapped recovery environments.
  • Experience with enterprise backup and recovery platforms, disaster recovery planning, and recovery validation.
  • Knowledge of data replication, enterprise storage, SAN/NAS concepts, and backup lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with VMware virtualization, Linux, and Windows administration.
  • Understanding of security hardening, access controls, privileged access management, and incident response procedures.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and root cause analysis skills.
  • Excellent documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and execute tasks efficiently.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of taking ownership of technical assignments with minimal direction.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cybersecurity, infrastructure, storage, and application teams.
  • Flexibility to support recovery operations and occasional schedule adjustments based on team workload.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in enterprise backup, storage, data protection, or cybersecurity administration.
  • Hands-on experience administering Dell Data Domain environments.
  • Experience supporting cyber recovery vaults or isolated recovery environments.
  • Experience with Dell CyberSense is required.
  • Experience participating in ransomware recovery testing, disaster recovery exercises, or business continuity initiatives.
  • Dell Proven Professional certifications or related data protection certifications are preferred.
  • Experience in regulated industries such as utilities, energy, financial services, or healthcare is a plus.
  • Experience with cloud-based backup and recovery solutions is desirable.

Investment Analyst



Day Rate Contract | Sydney | 6 months



· We are partnering with a leading Australian financial services organisation looking for an experienced Investment Analyst to join its Investments function.

· This is not a traditional Business Analyst or pure Data Analyst position. The team is looking for an investment generalist who can work across investment analysis, data, reporting and business processes, moving between different areas depending on the needs of the investment team.



Role

· Working closely with stakeholders across Investments, Data and Technology, you will support a broad range of investment and business process initiatives.



Key responsibilities

· Work across a range of initiatives within the Investments function, providing analytical, data and process support.

· Analyse investment and portfolio data to support investment teams and business decision-making.

· Work with fund structures, investment products, portfolios and investment data across multiple asset classes.

· Use SQL to interrogate, validate and analyse investment data.

· Work with investment and market data platforms including FactSet.

· Support ESG / responsible investment data, reporting and related initiatives.

· Undertake current-state and future-state process mapping across investment processes.

· Identify data issues, process inefficiencies and opportunities to improve controls, reporting and ways of working.

· Gather and translate business requirements while taking a broader approach than a traditional BA.

· Facilitate workshops and work closely with Investment, Data, Technology and Operations stakeholders.

· Support data quality, governance, reporting and continuous improvement initiatives.



Skillset

· The key to this role is breadth. You may currently be an Investment Analyst, Investment Data Analyst, Investment BA or Business Process Analyst, but you will be comfortable working outside the traditional boundaries of your job title.



Ideally, you will bring:

· Strong investment domain knowledge, ideally from superannuation, asset management or investment management.

· Good understanding of fund structures and investment portfolios.

· Experience with FactSet or similar investment/market data platforms.

· Exposure to ESG / responsible investment data and reporting.

· Hands-on SQL capability and confidence working with investment data.

· Experience across business process analysis, process mapping and process improvement.

· Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn complex investment data into practical insights.

· Ability to operate across Investments, Data and Business Analysis rather than specialising solely in one area.

· Strong stakeholder management skills, particularly with investment professionals.

· A pragmatic, adaptable approach and willingness to work across a variety of initiatives.



The Opportunity

· This role would suit a genuine Investment Generalist – someone who understands investments but also has the data and business process capability to solve a variety of problems.

· You don't need to be the deepest specialist in every area. The key is being able to understand an investment problem, interrogate the underlying data, map the associated processes and work with stakeholders to determine the best way forward.
